Independent source-HEAD rejudgment correcting the existing enforced assurance immediately, separate from the unpublished working-tree legacy tag package. Read RFC4271 Section5 general context and the full conditional sentence: "If a path with an unrecognized transitive optional attribute is accepted and passed to other BGP peers, then the unrecognized transitive optional attribute of that path MUST be passed, along with the path, to other BGP peers with the Partial bit in the Attribute Flags octet set to 1." This conditional output obligation does not prohibit stamping every other class. The separate Partial-zero obligation on well-known/nontransitive attributes and the following recognized-attribute prohibition remain distinct. Default behavior is assessed without removing explicit policy or RS-client transparency extensions.

This verdict is judged over SOURCE HEAD, not the working tree. Preserve ALL FIVE existing HEAD tagged tests/units and both existing polarities unchanged: reactor/rfc4271_test.go::TestRFC4271PartialSetOnUnrecognizedTransitiveOptional and ::TestRFC4271PartialNotSetOnRecognizedOrNonTransitive; core attribute/rfc4271_test.go::TestRFC4271PartialStampedOnUnrecognizedTransitive and ::TestRFC4271PartialNotStampedOnExcludedClasses; test/plugin/rfc4271-partial-unknown-transitive.ci. Native source-head stamping must derive these bindings from HEAD. The two proposed storage unknown250/251 positive claims exist only in the working tree and are NOT included in this HEAD judgment. No tag, test input, assertion, requirement text, level, summary annotation, owner ruling or recorded proof is changed by this correction.

The positives remain useful within their actual boundaries: core tests literal short/extended unknown stamp bytes and count, reactor direct validation checks ActionNone and unknown E0 after publication, and the functional test configures accepting policies and non-RS-client sessions using attached bgp-rs forwarding, requiring receiver bytes E0FA04DEADBEEF. These are retained source scopes, not a new claim of runtime or a complete ordinary selected-RIB matrix. Direct minimal Session fixtures have no genuine negotiated source lifecycle; their empty AS_PATH is not evidence of actual external Session admission.

The genuine finding is BOTH existing negative tags: TestRFC4271PartialNotStampedOnExcludedClasses and TestRFC4271PartialNotSetOnRecognizedOrNonTransitive assert ORIGIN40/MED80, which belong to neighboring4.3-2, plus recognized COMMUNITYC0, a supplementary current normalization/control case outside the UNKNOWN-transitive condition. A fault that stamps these excluded classes can fail both tests while every accepted-and-passed unknown transitive attribute still has Partial1, so it does not violate the quoted5-3 MUST. Syntactic negative coverage is therefore insufficient to support the existing enforced verdict. Keep every useful control and all tags/assertions intact; independently reviewed genuine pass-along evidence and a separately authorized classification repair are active required work, not waived or parked debt. Do not extend the separate5-4 owner proposal, invent an owner ruling or change the denominator.

No new runtime, accepted native receipt, wire observation or current-record freshness is asserted here. In particular, the main-reported working-tree short-storage receipt is outside this HEAD-only judgment. This correction requires no unpublished generic/Prefix-SID producer dependency, no working-tree storage bindings and no new code map; the existing HEAD audit had none. Native audit-stamp source head must compute all requirement/test/unit fingerprints itself. The audit change alone is independently committable before the owner-gated tag package.
